Exclude contacts covering at most 0.001% of a state's display area. Rank each state's regional crops by display overlap at the highest zoom with any overlap. The overview is the level-1 crop with greatest display overlap, or level 0 if unavailable.

geometries.method: Midpoint of the observed subsurface Azores Countercurrent latitude band at the 24.5°W October–November 2009 section; not a full path.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: The 110 km figure below is width across one 2009 meridional section at 24.5°W, not along-current length or a whole-current extent.

measurements.source_locator: Abstract [1] and Section 4 Discussion and Conclusions [15], October 2009 section at 24.5°W; each current has 110 km meridional width

named_current_source_observations.spatial_basis: The paper reports the Azores Countercurrent between 35.25°N and 36.25°N at 24.5°W. This is a cross-stream band, not an along-current trace.
named_current_source_observations.state_boundary_limit: The reported cross-stream band intersects the approximate NAST E polygon; the state boundary and observed current extent are not surveyed together.
named_current_source_observations.time_detail: The 17 stations of the wider 24.5°W section were occupied 26 October–1 November 2009; the exact occupation dates of this current band are not separately assigned here.
